description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans distributed application framework, specifically testing the catalog's ability to prevent duplicate grain activations under high concurrency. It defines a test class 'DuplicateActivationsTests' with setup configurations and a stress test method 'DuplicateActivations' that simulates high contention scenarios to verify activation guarantees.

classes.name: DuplicateActivationsTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies the Orleans catalog's ability to prevent duplicate grain activations under high concurrency. It sets up the test environment and contains the stress test method.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: A fixture class for setting up the Orleans test cluster with custom configuration.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo to increase response timeout during stress testing.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides the base method to add custom silo configuration.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets the response timeout for silo messaging options to 1 minute.

methods.name: DuplicateActivations
methods.description: The main stress test method that creates multiple grains and triggers high concurrency activation requests to test for duplicate activation prevention.
